entries.instruction: The face must read unmistakably SKEPTICAL and must NOT repeat this character's deadpan face. Draw the doubt in the geometry: ONE eyebrow raised clearly higher than the other in a visible asymmetric arch, the eyes narrowed to a doubting squint rather than open half-lids, and the mouth a flat line pulled to one side.
